text: deepseek-dovetail 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的技能扩展，把八个 Dovetail 工作流打包为 Cordis bundle。它注册 dovetail 文件系统 provider，从包内目录提供技能，涵盖提示词设计、技能创作、子代理编排、评审、自我对弈、SPARK 诊断和会话交接。用户可在 DSH 会话浏览或调用技能。适合希望复用这些 agent 工作流的用户；需要兼容的 Harness 和 Node.js。

deepseek-dovetail adds eight Dovetail skills to DeepSeek Harness with a Cordis bundle and local filesystem provider. Skills support prompt design, skill authoring, subagent workflows, evaluation, self-play, and session handoff. Browse or invoke them in DSH. Requires compatible Harness and Node.js.
想让 DSH 帮我把模糊需求整理成结构清楚、约束明确的提示词。
我需要为复杂任务设计合适的 DSH 子代理分工和交接提示。
Help me turn a rough request into a precise prompt with explicit constraints and an output format.
deepseek-dovetail 的功能「提示词结构化」：将模糊目标拆成任务、证据、约束和输出格式，并用语义容器、层级和占位符组织提示词。用户在 DSH 中调用 prompt-engineering 技能来起草、调试或改写提示。
deepseek-dovetail 的功能「子代理编排」：根据任务是否适合拆分来决定委派方式，并组织独立子代理提示、并行调用和后续交接。用户在 DSH 中使用 subagent-composition 技能规划代理协作流程。

deepseek-dovetail README · Introduction：`deepseek-dovetail` brings eight [OpenCnid Dovetail](https://github.com/OpenCnid/dovetail) workflows to [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) as one out-of-tree Cordis bundle. DSH remains the sole agent runtime; this package mounts an immutable, package-local skill tree through DSH's published filesystem provider.

deepseek-dovetail README · Why use it?：- **One install, eight workflows:** prompting, skill authoring, delegation, evaluation, self-play, agent steering, and session handoff.
- **Small runtime seam:** one Cordis row and one effect-owned filesystem provider—no replacement agent loop or skill registry.
- **Quiet on load:** no network access, update check, script execution, watcher, or writes to project/user skill homes.
- **Reproducible:** upstream content is commit-pinned and hash-locked; package, integration, UI, and bounded behavioral evidence live in the repository.

deepseek-dovetail README · Quick start：Requirements: DeepSeek Harness `v0.1.0-rc.7`, Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24`, and pnpm `11.x`.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/OpenCnid/deepseek-dovetail.git
cd deepseek-dovetail
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm run build

Install the generated tarball into any DSH profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add {ABSOLUTE_PATH}/artifacts/deepseek-dovetail-0.1.0.tgz
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

Replace `web` with another profile name as needed. Remove the bundle with:

deepseek-dovetail README · Quick start：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove deepseek-dovetail
```

In a DSH session, type `/` to browse skills or invoke one directly, for example `/prompt-engineering`. Six skills are model-discoverable; `spark-steering` and `upsum` are intentionally user-only.

deepseek-dovetail README · Skill gallery：Each original SVG gives the workflow a visual shorthand. Expand **Real DSH output** for an example generated through the installed bundle in the pinned DSH web profile—not a mockup. Six skills are model-discoverable and slash-invocable; `spark-steering` and `upsum` are intentionally slash-only.

deepseek-dovetail README · Skill gallery：The captures use the assembled `deepseek-dovetail@0.1.0` profile with GPT-5.6 Terra. They are illustrative runs, not universal evaluation claims; exact prompts and capture conditions are recorded in [the example manifest](docs/assets/examples/README.md). A machine-readable [UI snapshot](evidence/assembled/web-ui.snapshot.json) covers all eight catalog entries.

deepseek-dovetail README · Architecture：```text
DSH profile
  -> deepseek-dovetail bundle row
  -> deepseek-dovetail Cordis plugin
  -> @deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem

The provider is named `dovetail`, excludes default roots, disables watching, and resolves its bundled directory from installed code. Project and user skill roots keep their normal precedence.

deepseek-dovetail README · Work on the bundle：Edit DSH adaptations in `ports/dsh/`; never hand-edit pinned `vendor/dovetail` files or generated `dist/skills` output. See [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for repository rules and the complete validation workflow.

```sh
corepack pnpm run typecheck
corepack pnpm run lint
corepack pnpm run test
corepack pnpm run build

To refresh the pinned upstream subset from an exact, clean checkout:

```sh
corepack pnpm run sync:upstream -- --source {ABSOLUTE_PINNED_DOVETAIL_CHECKOUT}
```
deepseek-dovetail README · Work on the bundle：The sync fails closed on a wrong commit, dirty source, symlink, path escape, unclassified runtime file, or manifest/hash mismatch.

deepseek-dovetail README · Evidence and deeper documentation：- [COMPATIBILITY.md](COMPATIBILITY.md) — pinned host contracts and the skill-by-skill port matrix.
- [evidence/REPORT.md](evidence/REPORT.md) — package, profile, UI, removal, and behavioral acceptance ledger.
- [evidence/behavioral/LIVE_REPORT.md](evidence/behavioral/LIVE_REPORT.md) — bounded real-provider comparisons and known gaps.
- [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) — provenance, retained licenses, notices, and code-license status.

deepseek-dovetail README · Public-source status and limitations：This GitHub repository is public. The npm manifest deliberately remains `private: true`, no npm package has been published, and no owner-selected public license currently covers the new adapter/build/test code. Public visibility does not imply a license grant; review [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) before reuse or redistribution.

deepseek-dovetail README · Public-source status and limitations：Initial assembled acceptance is Windows-only. The changed/unchanged live `upsum` lifecycle remains `UNMEASURED` on the pinned Windows restricted-subprocess path, and the recorded behavioral comparisons are bounded evidence—not universal effectiveness claims.
